title: diff-driven mini-deploy validation for private control plane
creator: Riley Morgan
description: Problem: Full control-plane canary rollouts for VPC/private deployments are brittle and expensive to exercise at scale. We need a lightweight, fast validation step that detects behavioral deltas introduced by a new control-plane version before promoting broader cohorts. This ticket implements a 'diff-driven mini-deploy' stage: deploy a minimal control-plane variant to a tiny tenant slice, run fast automated contract and behavior diff checks derived from production traffic patterns, and surface deterministic pass/fail signals to the orchestrator. The goal is to reduce blast radius and shorten upgrade feedback loops while keeping costs and tenant churn low.
context: Current canary flow spins up full replicas and routes synthetic or mirrored traffic for 30–60 minutes. That catches many regressions but is slow and often redundant for minor control-plane changes (config schema bumps, RBAC rule tweaks, rollout orchestration fixes). We want an intermediate, low-cost gate that provides early detection for regressions affecting API contracts, resource reconciliation, and common error modes.
proposed_solution: 1) Define a lightweight 'mini-deploy' topology (single control-plane replica + ephemeral webhook proxy + limited operator sidecars) that can be provisioned via a Terraform module with a single variable toggle. 2) Generate a deterministic diff test harness: capture a short, bounded sample of production traffic templates (API calls, seq length distribution, reconciliation events) and run them against both baseline and candidate in parallel. 3) Compute a small set of behavioral diffs (HTTP status distribution, reconciliation latencies, error taxonomy fingerprints, RBAC-deny delta). 4) If diffs exceed threshold, mark mini-deploy as failed and annotate orchestrator with failure reason and reproducible scenario. 5) Integrate decision outputs into existing rollout controller (compatible with canary controller) so larger cohorts are blocked until diff is resolved or overridden by operator.
rollout_plan: Phase A (prototype): implement Terraform module and harness for one private-region lab tenant. Phase B (validation): run mini-deploys for 5 scheduled patch upgrades and refine diff thresholds. Phase C (adopt): wire signals to automated rollout controller and enable for non-critical tenants by default. Final: document operator override and runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module 'mini_deploy' able to provision/destroy topology in < 10 minutes
Harness runs parallel baseline vs candidate tests and produces a summarized diff report (JSON + human-readable)
Diff metrics include status code distribution, median reconciliation latency, top-5 errors with stack fingerprints, and RBAC-deny delta
Automated decision: candidate marked PASS if all diffs below configurable thresholds; FAIL otherwise
Rollout controller consumes the decision URL and blocks promotion on FAIL; operator can override with audit log entry
End-to-end smoke test documented and reproducible in private lab environment
tasks: Design Terraform mini_deploy module: variables, outputs, lifecycle hooks
Implement mini-deploy Helm chart variant or Kustomize overlay
Create traffic template extractor to sample production API templates (anonymized)
Build diff harness service that replays templates and computes metrics
Add diff threshold config (per-metric) and an assertion engine
Expose result as signed decision artifact (URL + checksum) consumable by rollout controller
Integrate decision consumer into rollout controller and add blocking logic
Write runbook for manual inspection and override steps
Create CI job to exercise mini-deploy on PRs touching control-plane API contracts
risks: False positives from non-deterministic production templates could block safe upgrades
Mini-deploy topology may not reproduce certain distributed failure modes (eg multi-replica races), giving false negatives
Privileged access needed to sample production templates — requires careful PII/anonymization work and approvals
Operator override misuse could bypass safety if not audited
telemetry_and_metrics: Record mini-deploy start/finish times, diff metric values, decision outcome, tenant slice ID, and artifact checksum. Emit traces for replay requests and reconciliation sequences. Dashboard: mini-deploy success rate over time, average time to decision, and top diff contributors.
notes: We purposely avoid full traffic mirroring to reduce infra costs. The goal is early semantic detection for API/contract/regression classes; high-risk changes should still go through full canary. Work with Security to define sampling/anonymization policy. Align thresholds with Product for customer-impact-sensitive rules.
